scripts.deapk: sh -c 'BUILD_NO="$1"; if [ -z "$BUILD_NO" ]; then BUILD_NO="$(env | awk -F= '\''/^npm_config_[0-9]+=/{ sub(/^npm_config_/, "", $1); print $1; exit }'\'')"; fi; BUILD_NO="${BUILD_NO#--}"; if [ -z "$BUILD_NO" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run deapk --20 or npm run deapk -- 20"; exit 1; fi; rm -f android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle && npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk app/build/outputs/apk/debug/integrix-${BUILD_NO}.apk && echo "APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/integrix-${BUILD_NO}.apk"' --
scripts.bsapk: sh -c 'BUILD_NO="$1"; if [ -z "$BUILD_NO" ]; then BUILD_NO="$(env | awk -F= '\''/^npm_config_[0-9]+=/{ sub(/^npm_config_/, "", $1); print $1; exit }'\'')"; fi; BUILD_NO="${BUILD_NO#--}"; if [ -z "$BUILD_NO" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run bsapk --20 or npm run bsapk -- 20"; exit 1; fi; rm -f android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/integrix-${BUILD_NO}.apk && echo "APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/integrix-${BUILD_NO}.apk"' --
scripts.bsaab: sh -c 'BUILD_NO="$1"; if [ -z "$BUILD_NO" ]; then BUILD_NO="$(env | awk -F= '\''/^npm_config_[0-9]+=/{ sub(/^npm_config_/, "", $1); print $1; exit }'\'')"; fi; BUILD_NO="${BUILD_NO#--}"; if [ -z "$BUILD_NO" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run bsaab --20 or npm run bsaab -- 20"; exit 1; fi; rm -f android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab app/build/outputs/bundle/release/integrix-${BUILD_NO}.aab && echo "AAB: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/integrix-${BUILD_NO}.aab"' --
scripts.commit: sh -c 'MSG="$*"; if [ -z "$MSG" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run commit \"commit message\""; exit 1; fi; git add . && git commit -m "$MSG"' --
scripts.push: sh -c 'MSG="$*"; if [ -z "$MSG" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run push \"commit message\""; exit 1; fi; git add . && git commit -m "$MSG" && git push origin HEAD' --
